Hi Joanna — no problem and thanks for the error details — that helps. Two quick possibilities for a 401:
1) The header is malformed — make sure you're sending Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (no extra quotes).
2) You're hitting our production hostname with a trial key; interchange of sandbox vs prod endpoint is common. Use https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai for trial keys.

Minimal Node snippet (Node 18, fetch):
```js
const res = await fetch('https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_trial_xxx' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello from Node' })
});
const data = await res.json();
console.log(data);
```

I attached a temporary sandbox key (temp-sandbox-key.txt) you can drop into the snippet to verify connectivity. Please treat it as ephemeral. If you'd prefer a pairing call, I have availability:
- Tue Nov 3, 2:00–3:30 PM PT (I can do 2:15 or 2:45)
- Wed Nov 4, 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu Nov 5, 9:00–11:00 AM PT (block slots)

If none of those work, I'm happy to do an async troubleshoot: paste the curl output or the SDK stack trace and I'll diagnose.

Also looping in Marissa from CS in case she wants to take the pairing call — Marissa, Joanna prefers afternoons next week and hit 401 with the trial key.

Best,
Sean
